splash.caption: Official {STEMRacing} Team!
splash.subheading: Proud winners of {awards} and Luxembourg's representatives at the {finals}

item1.title: Team Creation
item1.text: In October 2022, the first generation of Icarus was formed with our original members; Celia, Nikos, Lukas, and Maria.

item2.title: National Competitions
item2.text: Throughout 2022 and 2025, we attend a total of 3 National Finals in Luxembourg, and 2 showruns, winning multiple trophies along the way.

item3.title: World Finals
item3.text: In June 2025, we qualified to represent Luxembourg at the World Finals in Singapore. We worked tirelessly all summer to then participate in September.
